gentil-2024-yazoo.citation: Gentil et al. (2024), Distribution, Mixing, and Transformation of a Loop Current Ring Waters: The Case of Gulf of Mexico, Geophysical Research Letters 51, e2024GL110845.
gentil-2024-yazoo.access: Original published article acquired from the HAL institutional archive, with archive cover page. Actual PDF pages 3, 4 and 7 (article pages 2, 3 and 6) visually reviewed for the explicit Yazoo name, map averaging window and approximately 150 km high-ADT-patch radius. Original figure not republished.

furey-2022-yazoo.citation: Furey, West-Mack and Robbins (2022), UGOS GODEEP Cruise Report, R/V Pelican PE23-07, 1–5 October 2022, Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution.
furey-2022-yazoo.access: Original WHOI cruise report acquired. Actual PDF pages 2 and 12 visually reviewed. The abstract explicitly gives 2.5-knot currents while traversing Yazoo eastern flank; section 7 supplies circulation context. No plotted vector speed digitized and no instrument-depth assignment made from nearby figures.

accepted_references.radius_definition: Source-described circular patch of high absolute dynamic topography
accepted_references.current_support: Source cruise narrative, 1–5 October 2022; exact sample time, instrument depth and mean/maximum statistic unspecified

decisions: Direct approximate source radius retained; no inferred diameter, area, principal widths or physical polygon.
October cruise currents and November map radius are separate observations, not simultaneous measures or seasonal extrema.
The explicit source name supports a qualified named-case reference. It does not resolve registry separation conventions, splits, reattachments or the Yazoo II identity.
Source map is an eleven-day average; not a single daily footprint. Methods cite a tracked ADT eddy, not the OSW fixed 0.17 m contour operator.
